title: With no name typed, the blue line says "This term"
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Note today's date on the calendar of the test location (date A).
  • Work out date B: date A plus 30 days.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type 30 in the Days box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Credit Term" window opens.

Step 2:

  • The blue line reads: "This term means payment is due 30 days after the invoice date. An invoice dated date A is due date B." and no Name error shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-R5, empty name and dates: “With the Name empty, "{Name}" reads "This term". Dates read as a short month and day ("Oct 21"). The line updates as the user types and disappears while the number is invalid.”
  • S3-R10: “The Name is checked only once the user has typed in it (then each time they leave the field) or presses Create / Save. Opening the window, or clicking an option or a box before typing a name, never shows a Name error.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
